verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED: two blocking findings. M1 delivers what was asked. :core:common is pure JVM, :core:mvi follows A6.1 (main-thread jobs map, lazily started keyed jobs, a subscription-gated observe with a 5 s grace, onUnexpected). :core:model and :core:coroutines are deleted, every feature and data module has an api/ package with everything else internal, and every ViewModel is migrated to Appeared, launchLatest/launchExclusive and observe, with TextFieldState fields saved through SavedStateHandle.saveable. The Related rows (related_row) and primary_list are in place, ModuleGraph covers both shapes with verifyApiPurity and @OutputFile markers, and the required tests exist and are not weakened, including MviViewModelTest, the auth cases and the Robolectric process-death test. The acceptance log ($OV/out/WP02/logs/accept-m1.log) ends ACCEPT OK on the final commit. Both blocking findings are small fixes. (1) A newly added test file is not removed with the `forms` feature, so every project generated without `forms` (including the lean feature set) fails to compile its tests. I confirmed this by generating tests/spec_minimal.json and a lean feature list into the scratchpad. (2) Search runs distinct DataStore writes under one launchLatest key, so a later write can cancel an earlier one and lose it. The old queued handler applied every write. I changed nothing in the repo. The scratch projects I generated have been deleted.

blocking.problem: New test for a feature-owned package that the generator does not remove with that feature. In generator/genkit/spec.py:244-247 the `forms` feature owns only core/common/src/main/.../validation and core/ui/src/main/.../form. With `forms` off (lean preset, spec_minimal, `none`), Validators.kt is deleted but ValidatorsTest.kt stays. `:core:common:compileTestKotlin`, and therefore `./gradlew build` and `check`, fails in every such generated project. Verified: generating tests/spec_minimal.json and a lean feature list leaves core/common/src/test/.../validation/ValidatorsTest.kt with no validation/ main package. The template compiles because it has every feature on, and the generator unit tests do not compile output, so acceptance did not catch it.
blocking.fix: Add "core/common/src/test/kotlin/{pkg_path}/core/common/validation" to the `forms` Feature.files in generator/genkit/spec.py. This is touch-for-compile under Part D 2, and room's QueuedRequestReplayerTest entry already uses the same pattern. Add a generator unit test asserting that no test file is left under a removed feature path. Carry the same owns entry into forms.toml when M2 moves to WP01's catalogue.

blocking.problem: Distinct, non-idempotent writes share one latest-wins key. `RecentRemoved(a)` then `RecentRemoved(b)` both run `launchLatest(FORGET)`, and so does `ClearRecent`. The second call cancels the first while DataStore's edit is in flight, and DataStore aborts the transform when the caller is cancelled, so forget(a) is lost. The same applies to `remember()` at lines 125-127 (`launchLatest(REMEMBER)`), for example Submit "cats" followed quickly by a tap on the recent chip "dogs". The previous queued handleEvent applied every write. Settings.kt explains why launchLatest is safe there (absolute values). That reasoning does not hold here, and this is reference code others copy.
blocking.fix: Key each write by its argument so only a repeat of the same write replaces itself, e.g. `launchLatest("$FORGET:${event.query}") { repository.forget(event.query) }` and `launchLatest("$REMEMBER:$text") { repository.remember(text) }`. ClearRecent keeps its own key. Add a SearchViewModelTest case: two RecentRemoved events for different queries, with a gated fake, must both reach the repository.

nonblocking: core/common/src/main/kotlin/com/base/app/core/common/log/AppLogger.kt:15: unqualified `@Volatile` resolves through the JVM-only default import `kotlin.jvm.*`. In commonMain it needs `import kotlin.concurrent.Volatile`, so this file does not 'compile unchanged in commonMain' as the build-file comment (core/common/build.gradle.kts:1-5) and A2.2 promise. Add the explicit import, which works on the JVM too, before WP07's sync check finds it.

feature/search/.../SearchViewModel.kt:64-68: the TYPING watcher (`launchExclusive` + `snapshotFlow{}.collect`) lives as long as the ViewModel, for example while the search tab is kept. The comment saying a snapshot observer 'costs nothing while nobody types' overstates it: the apply observer runs on every global snapshot apply, i.e. every frame anything writes state. This deviation from A6.1 and A11.3 #10 is recorded (deviation 3). Consider a subscription-gated side-effect variant of `observe` in MviViewModel instead, and soften the comment.

A2.2 lists MviTestScope in :core:testing, but the package deletes it. The handoff mentions this only under 'What changed'. Either list it under 'Deviations', with the reason and the replacement (`state.launchIn(backgroundScope)` + MainDispatcherRule), or restore a version for the new API. :core:testing also still exposes `api(libs.mockk)`, which A2.2 forbids. That fix may fit M2's build hygiene work.

app/src/main/kotlin/com/base/app/session/SessionCoordinator.kt:50-56: the collector handles only `authenticated == true`. If the token store turns unauthenticated outside signOut() (e.g. A6.4's undecryptable token path), state stays SignedIn(n), and the next sign-in does not bump the generation. Handle `false` -> SignedOut, or note it for WP06, which rewrites this file.

app/src/main/kotlin/com/base/app/di/CoroutinesModule.kt:16: the KDoc says this is 'The one place `Dispatchers.*` is named', but core/network/.../NetworkClient.kt:44,60 (`Dispatchers.Default`) and core/ui/.../MviScreen.kt:49 (`Dispatchers.Main.immediate`) also name it. Reword it, or note that the NetworkClient uses are WP06's to inject.

feature/sample/.../list/SampleListScreen.kt:72-90: the `when` has no branch for `LoadState.Idle`, so the first frame before the Route's `Appeared` is handled renders empty content. SampleDetailScreen shows its skeleton for Idle. Treat Idle like Loading for consistency.

feature/auth/.../SignIn.kt:99-100 and SignUp.kt:94-96: when `observe` restarts after more than 5 s unobserved (backgrounded, or returning from Sign up), snapshotFlow re-emits the current text. The reducer then overwrites a 422 server field error with the local rule result. Minor UX regression; consider reducing only on actual text change, e.g. drop the first emission once errors have been shown.

feature/profile/.../ProfileViewModel.kt:97-100: if `repository.save` throws (DataStore IOException), guarded swallows it and `onUnexpected` is a no-op, so the user gets no feedback. Override onUnexpected or catch the error and show an error message.

data/feed/.../api/FeedRepository.kt:3 imports `androidx.paging.PagingData` into an api package. verifyApiPurity allows it (it forbids only `androidx.compose.`). The pure `:data:feed:api` in modular mode will need paging-common (F20, M2). Decide in M2 whether api purity should cover `androidx.` broadly, with an allowlist.
data/search/.../api/SearchRepository.kt:8: 'at most eight' copies `RecentSearches.LIMIT` into the doc, where it can go stale. Prefer wording that doesn't name the number.

build-logic/.../ModuleGraph.kt:244 reports only `file.name`; include the path relative to the project so the offending file is unambiguous. Lines 88-91: `tasks.matching { it.name == ... }.configureEach` realizes every task in each module. Prefer `tasks.named { it in setOf("preBuild", "compileKotlin", "check") }` (Gradle 8.6+). The pattern predates this change, but this diff extends it to `check`.

ModuleGraphTest covers path recognition and the edge rules, but not that test, variant and fixture configurations are collected (CHECKED_CONFIGURATIONS) or that the pure-module plugin check fires. Both are only exercised by the handoff's manual plant. Consider a small ProjectBuilder or TestKit test.
core/common/.../log/AppLogger.kt:26,30: argument order is `w(message, tag, throwable)` but `e(message, throwable, tag)`. Inherited from the old AppLogger; worth aligning while the API is new.

Only SignInViewModel is tested in feature/auth. SignUp's confirm-password and server-field mapping and PasswordReset's `sent` path have no tests. The WP lists only the sign-in cases, so this is a suggestion.

generator/genkit/spec.py:237-247: the `forms` description still promises 'per-field touched/error state', which FormState provided and which is now deleted. Update it with the M2 catalogue rewrite ("descriptions now true").

core/network/.../model/NetworkModels.kt:82-83: `NetworkResponse.fromCache`/`cachedAtEpochMillis` are now written but never read, because this package removed AppResult's freshness fields. The handoff acknowledges this as WP06's; keep it on WP06's list.
